extracted.name: Baked Corn Tortilla Strips for Mexican Soups
extracted.description: Baked corn tortilla strips are a staple in Mexican soups. Use them in your favorite tortilla soup or to garnish other Mexican soups or stews.
ingredient_lines: 2 tablespoons avocado oil, or more as needed
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Cut tortillas in half, then slice crosswise into 1/8-inch strips. Place strips into a bowl and toss with oil until fully coated.
Transfer oiled strips to a baking sheet and arrange in a single layer.
Bake in the preheated oven until crisp and lightly browned, about 15 minutes. Remove from the oven and let cool before using.
